chapter.verse: Upna thanemte pawlpih unla, ngaihsut kibanglo thute kinialpih kei un.
Mi khat in na khempeuh ka ne thei ci-in a up hangin upna thanem khat in anteh theipuam bek ne ngam hi.
A nete in a tangte enneu kei henla a tangte in a nete tungah thukhenna bawl kei ta hen. A hang pen Pasian in a nete zong sang khin hi.
Midang khat ii innsung nasem khat thukhenna a bawl dingin nang kua na hi hiam? Ama' kipna leh pukna vai a khen ding pen ama' Topa ahi hi.
Mi khat in nite lakah khat pen ni a dangte sangin hoihzaw ci-in a thupi-ngaihsut hangin a dang khat in ni khempeuh a kibangin ngaihsun hi. Mi kim in amau' lungsim ciat telcian tek ta hen.

Ni khatpeuh a tang mi in Topa' pahtawina-in a tang ahi hi. A ne mi in Pasian' tungah lungdam ko ahih manin Topa pahtawina tawh a ne hi a, a tang mi in zong Pasian' tungah lungdam ko ahih manin Topa pahtawina tawh a tang ahi hi.
A hang pen ei' lakah ama' ading beka a nungta, ama' ading beka a si, khat zong i om kei hi.
I nuntak leh Topa' adinga a nungta, i sih leh zong Topa' adinga a si, i hi hi. Tua hi a, eite i nungta-a i si zongin Topa' a i hi hi.
Hih thu hang mahin Khris pen misite leh a hinglaite' tunga ukna thunei ahih theih nadingin si-in nungta kik hi.
Bang hangin na sanggamte' tungah thukhenna bawl na hi hiam? Bang hangin na sanggamte enneu na hi hiam? I vekpi-in Pasian' thukhenna tokhom' mah-ah i ding ding hi.
A hang pen hih bangin kigelh hi: “Topa in a cihin ah, kei nungta ka hih mah bangin khuk khempeuh in kei hong bia ding uh a, leii khempeuh in Pasian phat ding uh hi.”
Tua hi a, eite khat ciat pen Pasian' mai-ah eimau' thulela tek a telgenkik ding i hi hi.
Tua ahih manin eite khatlekhat thukhenna kibawl nawn kei ni. Sanggamte khatpeuh a lampaina uhah palkhak ding ahi-a awk theih ding ahi zongin koih ngeilo dingin khensatzaw ni.
Ka tel thu leh Topa Jesu' sunga ka san thu ah, na khatpeuh ommuanin a sianglo cih bang om lo ahih hangin sianglo a ci peuhmah' adingin tua pen a sianglo ahi hi.
A hang pen na nek khatpeuh hangin na sanggam khat lungnop lo-in a om leh itna tawh a nungta na hi nawnkei hi. Khris in sihna thuakin a tat mi khat, na annekna tawh susia kei in.
Tua ahih manin hoih na sak uh thu, gendaina tuaksak kei in.
Banghanghiam cihleh Pasian' kumpigam cih pen nekledawn vai hilo a, Kha Siangtho sungah diktatna, nopna lemna leh nuamna cih thute ahi hi.
Tua bangin Khris' na a sem peuhmah Pasian' mai-ah a santaak, mite' mai-ah a muanhuai, ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin nopna lemna leh khatlekhat kilambehna lam a piangsak thute sulzuih ni.
An vai-in Pasian' sepsa thu susia kei ni. Na khempeuh a siang hi takpi a, ahi zongin an a nekna tawh a dang khat a puksak mi a khial ahi hi.
Sa nekna ahi-a lengtui dawnna ahi zongin na sanggamte a puksak thei thu khatpeuh sep loh ding mah hoih hi.
Na neih upna thu, nang leh Pasian kikal thu hisak in. Hi a sak thu hangin amahmah thukhenna a kibawllo mi thuphangah ahi hi.
Ahih hangin muanlahna a nei mi khat in a nek leh upna tawh a nek hilo ahih manin mawhsakna thuak hi. A hang pen upna pana hong pai ahilo peuhmah mawhna ahi hi.
